title: Check RMS fleet status UI to confirm RMS is up and running
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI as a quick health check to confirm RMS is reachable and displaying current fleet/status information so the OptiSweep system can be considered up and running.
when_to_use: Use after system events or when you need a fast confirmation that RMS is reachable and presenting fleet/status content.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open and verify RMS / fleet status UI reachability and whether it is displaying current fleet/status content.

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Training segment frame that explicitly instructs to check RMS to confirm everything is up and running (includes nearby note about SQL Server Configuration Manager / SQL Server Agent running).

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Start the health check by accessing the RMS fleet status page.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui).
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI is reachable and begins loading (i.e., you can view the page rather than seeing a blank/unreachable state).
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS page loads and shows fleet/status content (not blank/unreachable).
steps.failure_condition: The RMS page is blank, fails to load, or appears unreachable.

actions.label: Open RMS fleet status UI
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (RMS / fleet status UI).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: And then check RMS to make sure everything's up and running.

steps.title: Confirm RMS page loads and shows current fleet/status content
steps.purpose: Verify RMS is operating normally by confirming it displays current fleet/status information.
steps.instruction: On the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), confirm the page loads successfully and shows current fleet/status content (i.e., not blank/unreachable).
steps.expected_result: RMS / fleet status UI displays current fleet/status information.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see fleet/status content on the RMS page.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS page does not display fleet/status content (blank/unreachable).

actions.label: Verify fleet/status content is visible
actions.exact_action: Confirm the RMS page loads successfully and shows current fleet/status content (i.e., not blank/unreachable).

stop_or_escalate_if: RMS does not show fleet/status content (blank/unreachable)

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: And then check RMS to make sure everything's up and running.

steps.title: Interpret RMS health/error indicator (if present)
steps.purpose: Determine whether RMS indicates normal operation versus an outage/unreachable condition.
steps.instruction: If the RMS / fleet status UI shows an errors/health indicator, note whether it indicates normal operation versus an outage/unreachable condition.
steps.expected_result: You can classify the RMS health/error indicator as normal operation or outage/unhealthy/unreachable.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS health/error indicator (if shown) aligns with normal operation (not outage/unhealthy/unreachable).
steps.failure_condition: RMS health/error indicator (if shown) indicates outage/unhealthy/unreachable.

actions.label: Check RMS health/error indicator
actions.exact_action: If RMS shows an errors/health indicator on the UI, note whether it indicates normal operation versus an outage/unreachable condition.

stop_or_escalate_if: RMS indicates outage/unhealthy/unreachable via its health/error indicator

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: And then check RMS to make sure everything's up and running.

success_criteria: RMS / fleet status UI is reachable and displays current fleet/status information (not blank/unreachable).
healthy_conditions: RMS / fleet status UI loads and shows fleet/status content.
failure_conditions: RMS / fleet status UI is blank/unreachable.
RMS / fleet status UI health/error indicator (if present) indicates outage/unhealthy/unreachable.
escalation_guidance: If RMS is blank/unreachable or indicates an outage/unhealthy state, escalate for WCS/OptiSweep service health checks (including SQL Server Agent/service health) rather than assuming the system is up.
